summary: Tested the Lucette rename, the tips API share_url/page_url fields, the OG share page and its image, the 8 theme showcase APIs and /decouvrir pages, the conseils archive pages, the DailyTipCard share and archive links (on /bien-vieillir and the dashboard), the landing 'Découvrir' links, sitemap/robots, and the morning email tip block (pure function only, no emails sent). All 19 backend tests passed. All frontend flows passed on desktop and at 390px mobile.

issues: Mascot PNGs weigh 590-750KB (1024px) and load slowly on public SEO pages. Consider WebP or a resized version plus loading=lazy for the 'others' thumbnails, which load the same full-size PNG at 48px.

critical_code_review_comments: category_showcase: 'import random' sits inside the function. Move it to module level.
category_showcase loads every verified question id for a category on each call (a few hundred per category is fine). Consider caching per ISO week.

In share.py the location.replace({page!r}) line relies on Python repr to produce a JS string. It is safe here because date_key is regex-validated and FRONTEND_URL comes from env, but json.dumps would be more robust.
OG share HTML has no Cache-Control header. WhatsApp caches the preview anyway, so this is optional.
seed_data_creation: None. No emails sent; send_morning_emails and the admin trigger were not called.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Only one tip exists in preview (2026-11-10). The share page redirects humans via meta refresh and JS to /conseils-bien-vieillir/2026-11-10 (verified). The OG image is 1200x630 image/jpeg. Showcase returns 6 samples and 9 others per theme, stable across calls. The admin dashboard shows an onboarding modal on login.
